properties.title: LP GRS/NS Gadolinium 2° Elemental Abundance (low-altitude)
properties.lri:data_use_note: Gadolinium abundance in µg/g (equivalent to ppm) derived by multiplying the LP Samarium map by 1.17 — the mean Gd/Sm ratio in Apollo mafic impact melt breccias (Korotev 2000). Gd and Sm are co-derived from the same LP neutron spectrometer measurement (excess neutron absorption AΣeff); neither element can be independently resolved without this geochemical ratio as a constraint. Elevated in KREEP-rich terrains.
properties.lri:quality_note_short: Coverage limited to ~±71° latitude (polar caps masked as NoData). Negative pixel values within the data band are propagated from Sm counting-noise estimates, not missing data. The 1.17 Gd/Sm ratio is an approximation based on returned samples; the ratio varies between ~1.13 and ~1.38 across Apollo and Luna sites.
properties.measurement_depth: few tens of centimeters (bulk subsurface, not surface)
properties.processing:lineage: Derived from lp-samarium-2deg COG (samarium2d_COG.tif) by applying Gd = Sm × 1.17 (mean Gd/Sm ratio from Apollo mafic impact melt breccias, Korotev 2000) to positive pixels only. Negative pixels (counting-noise artefacts inherited from Sm) and the NoData sentinel (-9999) are propagated unchanged. No independent Gd binary exists in the PDS archive — the LP neutron spectrometer measures combined Gd+Sm absorption (AΣeff) and cannot resolve the two elements separately; the 1.17 ratio is the required constraint (Elphic et al. 2000). Written as COG via gdal_translate with DEFLATE/PREDICTOR=3 compression.
